description: Three references that do not resolve, and the two different facts they represent. A local part that is not an ongoing project id at all is locator_unknown (-32002): this adapter cannot read it. A well-formed id the catalog no longer holds is locator_expired (-32003): the project was removed, or it moved on disk and was recatalogued under the id its new canonical path produces — under ongoing's own identity rules a different project, and never grounds for returning a nearby one. The third is expired for a third reason worth separating: this source is configured with views = ["momentum"], and hnbooks is a real project this instance does not serve. That is the configured views filter working end to end, on the expansion side as well as the search side.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
